title: Spicy Lyrics Plus
description:
Spicy Lyrics Plus as your wallpaper: motion lyrics with every theme, word-by-word lyrics, Spotify Canvas and animated covers, translation and romanization, the song beside the lyrics, playback controls.

Settings: open the Spicy Lyrics Plus app (Start menu); every change shows here right away.

Install the app first: SpicyLyricsPlus-Desktop-Setup.exe from github.com/Kingexplosion707/Spicy-Lyrics-Android-Extra (it runs the relay that tells this wallpaper what plays, for Spotify and any other player).

settingsNote.text: Settings live in the Spicy Lyrics Plus app (Start menu) and apply here instantly.
